summary: Autohome Inc. filed a Form 6-K relating to its forthcoming annual general meeting (AGM) announcement in Hong Kong. The filing merely sets a record date (May 27, 2026) for determining holders of ordinary shares eligible to attend the AGM. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or any other special-situation transaction is involved. The announcement is a routine procedural notice for a shareholder meeting, not a transformative corporate event. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
